general_information.Description: By the end of the course, students will be able to understand: - E-Commerce and E-Marketplaces - Internet Consumer Retailing - Social media and commerce topics - Business-to-Business E-Commerce - Other EC Models and Application - EC Support Services - EC Strategy and Implementation - Launching a Successful Online Business
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises and practical given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time. - Constantly follow https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information.

description: By the end of the course, students will be able to understand: - E-Commerce and E-Marketplaces - Internet Consumer Retailing - Social media and commerce topics - Business-to-Business E-Commerce - Other EC Models and Application - EC Support Services - EC Strategy and Implementation - Launching a Successful Online Business

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Defne all types of e-commerce systems and describe their major business and revenue models, drivers, and benefts.
Describe all the major mechanisms that are used in executing e-commerce.
Describe all methods and models of selling products and services online from business to individual customers.
Understand all online business-to-business activities, including selling, procurement, auctions, and collaboration.
Describe EC activities other than selling online, such as e-government, e-learning/e-- training, e-health, and sharing economy.
Describe the major applications of artifcial intelligence in EC.
Describe social networks, social customers, and social software as facilitators of social commerce.
Describe the landscape of social commerce applications, including social shopping and advertising, social CRM, social entertainment, and crowdsourcing.
Describe the connected e-commerce and Internet of things and its smart applications.
Describe marketing and advertising in the Web environment.
Describe the use of e-payments, including mobile payments, and digital currency in e-commerce.
Understand order fulfllment in e-commerce and its relationship to supply chain management.
Understand e-commerce strategy and describe its process and steps, including justifcation, planning, implementation, and assessment.
Describe the global aspects of e-commerce.
Explain the issues of using e-commerce by small- and medium-sized companies.
Understand the ethical, legal, social, and business environments within which e-commerce operates.
Understand how to Launch a Successful Online Business and EC Projects

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why is EC needed? When did it appear, what are the necessary conditions for existence? What are the limitations of EC?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1.2
constructive_questions.Details: Why is B2B e-commerce so essential and successful?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ1.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why do users accept e-commerce companies? Which EC business model is suitable for Vietnam market?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ2.1
constructive_questions.Details: What is the electronic market? List their components?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ2.2
constructive_questions.Details: Why should online negotiation, online auction? What are the advantages and disadvantages of this problem?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ2.3
constructive_questions.Details: What are the risks of using web tools 2.0, 3.0, 4.0? How to limit risk in EC ?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ2.4
constructive_questions.Details: How can we use Facebook and other social networks in our business?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ3.1
constructive_questions.Details: What are the limitations of e-tailing? Where is e-tailing going?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ3.2
constructive_questions.Details: Why do online banking services exist? How to use credit card?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ3.3
constructive_questions.Details: What is the online job market? its benefits and limitations?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ3.4
constructive_questions.Details: How do online real estate services, online stock trading work?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ4.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why are there so many B2B models, explaining the main B2B models?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ4.2
constructive_questions.Details: How does an online exchange exist? describe their main types?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ4.3
constructive_questions.Details: What is Internet Marketing in B2B? detailed explanation including organizational buyer behavior?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ4.4
constructive_questions.Details: Why define the characteristics of the buy-side market in the B2B model?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ5.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why is it necessary to form e-government, what are the activities of e-government, the opportunities of e-government?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ5.2
constructive_questions.Details: How to design the most cost-effective e-government procurement system?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ5.3
constructive_questions.Details: How to implement e-government for citizens, businesses and government activities?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ6.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why do models such as e-learning, virtual universities and e-training exist?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ6.2
constructive_questions.Details: Describe the experience of Mobile commerce applications in banking and financial services?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ6.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why exploit the technological potential and applications of location-based mobile commerce?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ7.1
constructive_questions.Details: What does the Web 2.0 revolution mean? its characteristics and the context of social networks?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ7.2
constructive_questions.Details: What are the possible ethical issues associated with implementing social commerce?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ7.3
constructive_questions.Details: Why should social networks be used in advertising, market research, customer service, practical illustration?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ7.4
constructive_questions.Details: What are the main implementation issues of social commerce (including strategy, security and ROI)? Risks and barriers

constructive_questions.Name: CQ8.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why research the consumer market in EC, who will conduct the research?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ8.2
constructive_questions.Details: What is the method of online advertising on the web, the goal, the strategy?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ8.3
constructive_questions.Details: How does the consumer's online purchase decision process take place

constructive_questions.Name: CQ9.1
constructive_questions.Details: Why is it important to secure information systems with e-commerce? Strategy, budget, plan for security?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ9.2
constructive_questions.Details: What are the security threats of e-commerce? What are security holes and technical attacks?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ9.3
constructive_questions.Details: How to prevent fraud on the Internet? principles of information security.

constructive_questions.Details: What is the control and defense mechanism? why can't the computer stop in EC?

constructive_questions.Details: How to use electronic payment methods such as (e-wallets, credit cards...), solve problems when problems arise?

constructive_questions.Details: What payment methods should a B2C website support? Which payment methods should the C2C market use?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ10.4
constructive_questions.Details: Should we outsource our payment gateway service? How secure are electronic payments?

constructive_questions.Details: What is the role of support services in EC?

constructive_questions.Name: CQ11.3

constructive_questions.Name: CQ12.2

constructive_questions.Name: CQ12.3

constructive_questions.Name: CQ12.4

constructive_questions.Name: CQ13.3

constructive_questions.Name: CQ14.2
